equal_accuracy_MC_scaling.assumption: MC RMSE scales as N^-1/2 from the observed 3500-sample point

crossover_factors_per_qae_query.accuracy_caveat: Observed RQMC RMSE is already lower than observed MLAE RMSE, so cost below this line alone would not establish dominance.

dense_loader_negative_control.interpretation: upper-bound warning; not a lower bound and not used as the structured-loader estimate

conclusion: At the optimistic structured-loader proxy, noiseless MLAE is cheaper than extrapolated equal-RMSE crude MC but is more expensive and less accurate than the observed RQMC point. RQMC is the preferred estimator for the current primary case.
limitations: Arithmetic units are normalized proxies, not compiled Toffoli/T/depth counts.
The controlled oracle assumes reversible compute/uncompute around the existing spatial/tank update proxy.
The structured 11D loader is an optimistic parametric-copula rotation count and is not a compiled circuit.
Equal-RMSE MC cost extrapolates from one sample size using asymptotic square-root scaling.
Observed local surrogate timings and measured IBM QPU time are not converted into one wall-time claim.
